maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to scrape from the store.
maxProducts.title: Max Products

proxy.description: Proxy settings. Apify's own datacenter egress IPs are blocked by Shopify's edge WAF, so a proxy is required — the default Apify AUTO proxy (free) is sufficient for almost all stores. Switch to RESIDENTIAL only if you still get 403 errors.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

storeUrl.description: URL of the Shopify store to scrape. Can be the homepage or any page on the store (e.g., https://www.allbirds.com or https://shop-name.myshopify.com).
storeUrl.title: Shopify Store URL
